summaries.en: OpenAI is collaborating with America’s Small Business Development Center (SBDC) to enhance AI training and local support for small businesses. The partnership includes a new report detailing how small teams effectively utilize AI. The initiative aims to equip small businesses with practical AI skills and resources.

items.title: Introducing dots
items.content: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.
items.contentSnippet: Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in control while work moves forward.

summaries.zh: "OpenAI的Dots是一款主动式助手，能在复杂项目和日常任务中持续工作。它帮助用户在任务推进时保持掌控力。Dots可跨项目协作，提升工作效率。"
summaries.en: "Dots by OpenAI is a proactive assistant designed to support complex projects and daily tasks. It enables continuous work across various contexts, helping users maintain control as projects progress. The tool aims to streamline productivity by staying engaged and adaptive. Its key features include cross-project functionality and task management, ensuring seamless workflow. Dots is intended to enhance efficiency by keeping tasks moving forward without losing oversight."
